after use package::types::*, types is not in scope (fix: write User)
a bare User with no use is not in scope (fix, offered because User is declared in package::types: add use package::types::User, or write package::types::User)
types::User with no use is not rooted in a name in scope (fix, offered because the package declares types::User: add use package::types, or write package::types::User)
a bare Nowhere that no schema of the package or its dependencies declares is not in scope (no fix that adds a use is offered: nothing declares it)
nope::types::User, whose first segment matches no name in scope, root or schema, is not in scope (no fix that adds a use is offered: nothing is named nope)
use package::billing::Invoice and struct Invoice in the same schema define Invoice twice (fix: rename one, or import with an alias: use package::billing::Invoice as BillingInvoice)
use package::a::User and use package::b::User bring in User twice (fix: rename one, or import with an alias: use package::b::User as BUser)
use package::billing::api::Invoice as BillingInvoice beside a local Invoice defines each name once
use package::a::User beside use package::b::User as BUser defines each name once
